response.overview: Pedralbes: despertant la reina' chronicles an unprecedented archaeological and scientific investigation inside Barcelona's iconic Gothic monastery. Focusing on the recent study and restoration of its medieval tombs, the documentary bridges the gap between past and present.  Through state-of-the-art conservation techniques, bioarchaeology, and archival research, the film uncovers the hidden legacy of Queen Elisenda de Montcada and the silent community of women who shaped medieval society.  It is an intimate, visually captivating journey into the physical and spiritual heart of 14th-century heritage, revealing secrets preserved in stone for seven centuries.
response.title: Pedralbes: Despertant la Reina
